-- Lexes fine but ends early: a binary operator still waiting for its right
-- operand when the source stops. The layout pass closes the open block before
-- the stream ends, so the fault is the general parse code at a zero-width
-- caret on the virtual closer, not the exhausted-stream code, which only the
-- expression entry can reach.
fn broken() : Int = 1 +
